inputs: Frozen inputs.json from mgcv_scat_workflows, identity link, one cr smooth, positive weights and formula offset.
coverage: REML outer bfgs/optim/nlm, fixed and estimated degrees of freedom/scale; SP, coefficients, theta, EDF, criterion, likelihood, AIC, predictions, SE and covariance.
policy: Actual R snapshots; ordinary tests never invoke R.
controls: Six default-control references retained as evidence; optim endpoint acceptance uses two additional references with matched epsilon=1e-10 and optim.factr=10.
source_contract: initial.spg uses extended-family observed deviance curvature, falling back globally to expected curvature when any weight is negative; bfgs retains its approximate Hessian, while nlm/optim final derivative-free fits have no smoothing uncertainty correction. gam.fit4 retains converged IRLS coefficients during final covariance factorization; a captured initial BFGS coefficient, gradient and finite-difference inverse-Hessian state verifies this.
validation: Six normal no-R endpoint tests passed after source-exact extended-family initial.spg weighting and nlm derivative-free postprocessing corrections; tolerances unchanged.

source_provenance.execution: Fixtures load library(mgcv) from the installed R package; no vendored or checkout source files are sourced.

vendored_source_difference.difference: Only substantive difference is newton steepest-descent direction: vendor uses Sstep <- grad/max(abs(grad)); CRAN uses Sstep <- -grad/max(abs(grad)). Installed mgcv:::newton body was inspected and has the CRAN negative sign. Recorded CRAN hash is deliberate, not a transcription error. Other source hashes listed in this manifest match both trees.

source_files_sha256_scope: Hashes in source_files_sha256 identify the vendored files audited; fixture execution uses installed CRAN mgcv. See source_provenance for the gam.fit3.r difference and installed implementation evidence.
